snippet.title: The Disciples of the Full Moon [Full Game]
snippet.description:
Everyone has gone simply insane on the full moon, their bloodlust unquenchable. Slicing and Dicing with my cleaver was merely self defence on my fine nightly stroll. 

Game - The Disciples of the Full Moon
